items.title: A Game Engine For Microcontrollers
items.summary: If you wanted to make a game that ran on a commodity microcontroller, you could be forgiven for not knowing where to start. Never fear, for [Fedyfausto] has just the setup to help you in your quest. (Assisted by whatever LLM helped him write all that code, that is.) It’s called Jet Studio, and it’s an open-source game editor that looks and works like Godot. In reality, it’s a Godot app with a C++ GDExtension, and it’s for making games that run on an Arduino Nano ESP32 or an STM32F746. Specifically, it’s intended for use with the commonly-available ILI9341 SPI LCD display.

items.title: An Attempt At A Useful Desktop OS For Microcontrollers
items.originalTitle: An Attempt At A Useful Desktop OS For Microcontrollers
items.summary: We’re living at an interesting time here in 2026, when microcontrollers are becoming powerful enough to surpass the capabilities of “real” computers from a time when those real computers were starting to become useful. We’ve seen plenty of microcontrollers emulating machines from the 1990s, but what if instead they were giving all their power to the OS? It’s a question [Thomas] is trying to answer with SylphideOS, a general purpose GUI operating system aimed at multiple microcontroller platforms On the surface it has a GUI that appears to owe a lot to the early Macintosh machines, but underneath it has the FreeRTOS kernel, something that has been around for quite a while. You can argue among yourselves as to whether this make it an OS in its own right or a FreeRTOS distro. items.summary: [편집자주]2026 강릉 ITS 세계총회에서 만난 정구민 한국모빌리티학회 회장(국민대학교 전자공학부 교수)은 ITS의 가장 중요한 변화로 AI의 본격 도입을 꼽으며, 핵심 과제로 자율주행 고도화와 교차로 안전 향상을 제시했다. AI와 통신, 데이터 분석을 활용해 자율주행의 엣지 케이스와 안전 문제를 해결하는 것이 중요하다고 강조했다. 또한 한국 모빌리티 산업은 더 많은 데이터 확보와 글로벌 시장 진출이 필요하며, 자율주행·SDV·ITS를 결합해 안전성과 수출 경쟁력을 높여야 한다고 밝혔다. 이에 본지는 정구민 회장과 인터뷰를 통해 이번 세계 ITS 총회에서 주목해야 할 기술 트렌드와 한국 모빌리티 산업 발전을 위한 조언을 들어봤다. ■ 이번 세계 ITS 총회에서 가장 주목해야 할 기술 트렌드는 무엇이라고 보는지 결국 AI 기술이 본격적으로 ITS에 들어왔다는 점이 상당히 중요하고, 크게 두 가지를 봤으면 좋겠다.

items.title: How EMI Filtering Helps Reduce Unplanned Data Center Downtime
items.originalTitle: How EMI Filtering Helps Reduce Unplanned Data Center Downtime
items.summary: Jason Gildea, senior manager and Luc Mosca, global product manager, share insight about how AI demands increase cooling needs. As computing and processing demands grow with the rise of artificial intelligence (AI), the cooling needs in and other high-density computing facilities increase as well. From hyperscale data centers to high-density AI clusters, the growing power density of these facilities is generating more heat. This makes reliable and efficient cooling critical to help optimize performance and avoid costly slowdowns or downtime. Liquid cooling offers benefits for efficiency and performance compared to air-cooled systems in many of these applications.

items.title: Why 16-bit MCUs Still Matter for Smart Home Appliance and Industrial Applications
items.originalTitle: Why 16-bit MCUs Still Matter for Smart Home Appliance and Industrial Applications
items.summary: As smart home appliances and industrial systems become increasingly connected and feature-rich, the systems that drive them require high power efficiency and reliable operation at optimized costs. This is where the highly sustainable Renesas 16-bit MCUs play a very important role in these design priorities. As smart home and industrial applications become more capable, functions such as sensor monitoring, environmental control, and user interface management demand reliable, responsive operation. Designers must also minimize power consumption, control system costs, and support long product lifecycles. These requirements make 16-bit MCUs a critical foundation for delivering the right balance of performance, efficiency, and value.

items.summary: [편집자주]아우토크립트 2026 강릉 ITS 세계총회에서 자율주행과 미래 모빌리티의 성공 조건으로 ‘사이버 보안’을 가장 중요하게 강조했다. 보안이 확보되지 않으면 차량 해킹뿐 아니라 오작동으로 인한 안전사고가 발생할 수 있기 때문이다. 아우토크립트는 V2X 통신 보안 인프라(PKI)와 침입탐지(IDS) 기술을 통해 차량 간·차량과 인프라 간 통신의 신뢰성을 확보하고 있으며, 자동차를 넘어 모빌리티와 피지컬 AI 전반의 보안 환경 구축을 목표로 하고 있다. 이에 본지는 2026 강릉 ITS 세계총회 현지에서 심상규 아우토크립트 CTO와 만나 자동차 보안의 미래에 대해 들어봤다. ■ ITS와 자율주행 기술이 빠르게 발전하고 있는데, 왜 지금 보안이 가장 중요한 이슈로 주목받고 있나 지금 자동차, 특히 자율주행차가 매우 중요한 분야로 떠오르고 있다.
